objective: Define the durable submission identity and deterministic logical-request fingerprint contract required to make the existing public insurance quote-request ingress retry-safe without replacing relationshipId as canonical CRM identity.

architecture.submissionIdentity: HTTP Idempotency-Key, canonicalized independently from relationshipId
architecture.fingerprintInput: Canonical normalized logical quote-request content derived from accepted records while excluding generated IDs, server timestamps, and unrelated server-owned lifecycle/routing state.
architecture.sameKeySameFingerprint: Replay the originally created relationship in the later D1/API integration slice.
architecture.sameKeyDifferentFingerprint: Return deterministic conflict semantics in the later D1/API integration slice.
architecture.contactIdentityPolicy: Email and phone remain contact attributes and are not uniqueness keys.
architecture.productionPolicy: Migration 0009 is authored only and must remain unexecuted.
